name: AutoFactory Jev pre-classification mode
description: How much the pipeline trusts the optional Jev (TypeSafe AI) pre-classifier. It only takes effect when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set; without a key the layer is off whatever this flag serves. Before the chain runs, one Jev request answers the typed decisions the agents otherwise make inside their loops: risk_score, flag_worthy, pr_type/skip_flagging, flag_type, flag_action, feature_novelty, metric_backing, release_method, and which existing metrics the change could move. shadow = log the answers, compare them with the agents' decisions after the walk, and emit the autofactory-jev-preclassification event; agents never see them. prefill = shadow plus confident answers (>= 0.7) go into the entry node's prompt as evidence. Routing tags and approval gates always read the agents' own tags.

variations.name: Off
variations.description: No Jev request, even when a key is set.

variations.name: Shadow
variations.description: Ask, log, and compare with the agents; agents never see the answers.

variations.name: Prefill
variations.description: Shadow, plus confident answers go into the entry node's prompt as evidence.
